name: Drink the Ocean
summary:
You start on a small island with a tiny plastic straw and a lot of water in your way. Every sip lowers the sea a little and uncovers more of what’s underneath.

Walk out onto the seabed as it dries, pick up the treasure left behind, and sell it to the merchant for bigger, stronger straws. Your first sips barely make a ripple. A few upgrades later you’re pulling a whirlpool. Drink alone or with up to three friends, and keep going until the water drops far enough to reach the shipwreck, and whatever is below it.

The island never looks the same for long. Rocks you swam past become paths, chests turn up in the sand, and places that were deep water an hour ago are somewhere you can stand. There’s always one more straw to save for and one more stretch of seabed about to come up for air.
